name: ai-01
title: AI Chat with Voice Input
description: A ai chat with voice input block.

standards.purpose: Let a person hold a conversation with a model and see exactly what was sent.
useWhen: An assistant answers in turns and context accumulates.
doNotUseWhen: A single form submission covers the need.

rules.check: Streaming responses show progress and can be stopped.
A failed turn shows a retry path and keeps the user's message.
The composer has an accessible label, sends on Enter, and inserts a newline on Shift+Enter.
